info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-Create Airline Flights Checkin-v5-spec
info.description: The Airline Flights Check-in API provides airlines and travel service providers with the capability to manage passenger check-in for flights. By utilizing this API, users can submit passenger information and confirm check-in status, streamlining the boarding process. Typical consumers of this API include airline operators, travel agencies, and web portals that facilitate flight management. The API enhances operational efficiency and improves customer experience by enabling timely check-ins.

post.description: This operation allows a passenger to check in for their flight, ensuring they are formally registered for travel. It involves providing necessary identification and flight details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to check in passengers for flights. It includes necessary details such as passenger information and flight details to facilitate the check-in process.

200.description: Check-in completed successfully, and boarding details provided.

requestId.description: A unique identifier for the check-in request.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the flight.

customer.description: Details of the customer requesting check-in.

resource.description: The resource associated with the request.

priority.description: Priority level of the check-in request (1 being the highest).

amount.description: The amount related to the check-in operation.

currency.description: The currency in which the amount is specified.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates if a notification is required after processing the check-in.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp when the check-in request was made.

channel.description: The communication channel used for the request.

recordIndex.description: Index of the record in case of multiple requests.

CreateAirlineFlightsCheckinResponse_200.description: Response schema for the check-in operation, which indicates the status and details of the check-in process.
